name: sodium bicarbonate
summary: Human evidence supports sodium bicarbonate for high-intensity exercise performance, particularly repeated or sustained efforts where acidosis contributes to fatigue.
description: Human evidence supports sodium bicarbonate for high-intensity exercise performance, particularly repeated or sustained efforts where acidosis contributes to fatigue.
safetyNotes: GI distress, bloating, sodium load, and alkalosis risk; caution hypertension, kidney disease, and heart failure.
